_why: Unholy is the deepest of the three redesigns -- 18 of its 31 talents are
modified -- and the premade build already reaches most of them: Epidemic,
Hungry Dead, Master of Ghouls, Crypt Fever, Ebon Plaguebringer, Bone Shield
and Wandering Plague are all bought. What it misses is the survivability
half, which is exactly the half a solo death knight needs:
Harvest of Souls 2/2   (T3.1) Death Strike drains life from every
diseased enemy within 15 yards, scaled by the
number of diseases on each. With four diseases up
this is the whole of Unholy's self-sustain, and it
is a talent the premade build does not touch at
all -- the stock rotation has no Death Strike node
in the Unholy list either, which is why the solo
rotation adds one.
Desecration 2/2        (T5.0) Blood Strike and Blood Boil desecrate the
ground, raising disease damage taken. Every other
per-disease multiplier in the tree is already
bought; this is the one that scales them.
Grim Prophecy 1/1      (T2.2) Scourge Strike and Death Strike grant dodge
while wielding a two-handed weapon. One point, and
it keys off the two buttons this rotation presses
most.
Funded by trimming the 18-point Frost dip to 13. Endless Winter 2/2 goes --
it extends Horn of Winter and has Chains of Ice apply Frost Fever, neither
of which this build's disease plan depends on -- and Icy Talons drops from
5/5 to 2/5. Icy Talons cannot go entirely: Improved Icy Touch and Runic
Power Mastery hold tier 0 at 5, Black Ice and Nerves of Cold Steel take
tier 1 to 11, and cutting below that would silently drop everything under
it. What survives is what the diseases care about.
58 Unholy / 13 Frost.
